visualizerParams.title: Bug Squasher: call Used with an Array of Arguments
visualizerParams.problemDescription: The greeting should print Hi, Ravi?, but the program prints Hi,?, Raviundefined.

solution.explanation: call expects the arguments one by one. Passing an array to call makes the whole array the first argument (which turns into the text Hi,?) and leaves the second argument undefined. apply is the one that unpacks an array.
